problems: Cliopatria 'Kingdom of Arles' 1034..1384 (11 shapes) is Duchy of Burgundy land: 76 of 76 cells inside Duchy of Burgundy 1010 and 1385 shapes, 0 cells in the real Arles shape; send the strip to eu-10 duchy-of-burgundy (whose Cliopatria row skips 1018-1384). Also 75 of 76 cells in the Upper Burgundy row of 950.

The real Arles lands after 1032 are an imperial kingdom: Cliopatria's Holy Roman Empire shape covers 482 of 484 cells until 1259 and minor-state rows after 1260. The Arles dossier keeps a nominal shell with pieces removed (Basel 1006, Provence 1246, Vivarais 1306, Lyonnais 1312, Dauphine 1349, Savoy 1361); orchestrator decides how to draw it; eu-08-b should record Arles as an Empire component.

Kingdom of Germany ends February 962 (imperial coronation) while Cliopatria's Holy Roman Empire row starts 962: one year is drawn twice; colour/family agents should decide whether the Empire is the same state under a new title. Cliopatria's 961 shape shows all of Italy (623 cells, from Kingdom of Italy) for the whole of 961 though Otto took the kingship at Christmas 961 and held it as Berengar II's vassal kingdom from 952.

Cliopatria's Kingdom of Lower Burgundy (900..935) has a 954-cell shape reaching Italy and overlaps Arles by 294 cells in 933-935; Upper Burgundy rows (887..959 and 922..925) are different lands; eu-07 should settle the predecessors. Germany's 926 loss of 17 cells (Basel to Zurich) goes to Upper Burgundy in Cliopatria and to Arles from 936.
No page opened gives an infobox area (Kingdom of Germany, East Francia, Kingdom of Arles all lack one); area comparison was impossible for both states.

WebFetch returns an extraction by a small model, not raw page text; quoted sentences are as returned. The Rudolph II of Burgundy page was opened once and is cited by both dossiers (Germany therefore cites 6 pages against its 5-page budget, Arles 9 of 9).

Several analyses (cell overlaps between Cliopatria shapes, coverage of gazetteer regions) were computed with the gazetteer module in /tmp/claude-0/work/research-eu-08-a/ and are stated in keyframe notes as measurements, not page content.
